pages.text: Every closed surface is a sphere with handles or with cross-caps (where it passes through itself and turns one-sided). Its Euler characteristic, V − E + F for any net drawn on it, is χ = 2 − 2g − c, and it does not change however the surface is stretched. The kiln must give the recipe's χ and the right number of sides.
$(thing)Set$(): Handles, Cross-caps, Kiln temperature.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Uneven heat: the firing rate varies by ±2%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): The clay slumps.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Hotter is faster.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Euler characteristic: χ = 2 − 2g − c$(br)Matches the recipe: χ = X, one-sided = N$(br)Firing rate: r ∝ e^(−T₀/T)
